PAINTING & BODYWORK — FAST PAINTING FACILITY

Painting & bodywork to a luxury standard

From a parking scratch to full collision repair: every case is assessed — usually from photos first — then executed at QSC's dedicated painting facility.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork

Most painting customers arrive with one question in mind: how bad is this damage, really? The Fast Painting facility was built to answer that question quickly and honestly. Send photos of the damage by WhatsApp or through the form and the painting team replies with an initial read — polish, localized repair, panel work or a fuller scope — then confirms it physically when the car arrives. Everything that follows, from surface preparation to color matching to final finishing, happens in a facility dedicated to paint alone: controlled spray booths, a color lab and chassis-measurement equipment, far from the dust of mechanical work.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can I get an assessment without visiting the workshop?

Yes — that is the Fast Painting way. Send clear daylight photos of the damage by WhatsApp or through the booking form, and the painting team replies with an initial read and realistic options within working hours.

Will an insurance company accept QSC's repair?

Bring your claim details to the assessment and the team explains exactly how the process runs with your insurer, including the documentation the workshop provides — damage reports, photos and, where relevant, structural measurement records.

Will the repair be visible afterwards?

The purpose of proper paint matching, blending and finishing is that it is not. Where a specific color or damage presents a genuine limitation, you are told before the work — with test cards where useful — never after.

How long does paint repair take?

Honestly: it depends on the damage, the preparation needed and cure times, which are never rushed. You receive a realistic duration for your specific job at assessment, and the painting team keeps you informed if anything changes it.
